name: Kaja Guðmundsen
description: Twelve years old — at the closing edge of the juvenile neuretics growth window (SS-A21). Her cheap-bracket provisioning is settling wrong at the cochlear feeds; the corrective integration procedure exists, works, and is priced for Sky People. The fund is Φ8,400 short. Present in the story mostly in absence: the cost of every vote, the clock under the clock. On-page sparingly — a kid doing homework in the commons, wearing the ear shielding she hates.

core_fears: The adults going quiet when she walks in
core_desires: For sound to stop arriving wrong
For her mother to stop doing the arithmetic out loud at night
coping_mechanisms: Naming the bloc's sounds she can still hear right

speech_patterns.vocabulary: A kid's — direct, unsentimental about her own condition.
speech_patterns.cadence: Short. Asks the question adults are avoiding.
example_lines: The floor sounds different since Tuesday. Nobody else hears it?

story_hooks: The corrective window closing at the same rate the bloc descends
narrative_function: The human number the jettison ledger must answer to. Present in absence.
